items.docs: Sends a transactional email message to a specific customer. You can compose the entire message in the request body or use a transactional message template. Transactional messages are triggered by user actions such as password resets, purchase confirmations, and account notifications. Rate limited to 100 requests per second.
Sends a transactional push notification to a specific customer. The customer must have at least one registered device to receive the notification.
